common_frame: Prediction x horizontal/rightward and y upward; ZNMF downstream points upward after +90 degree analysis-copy rotation
diameter_source_or_assumption: User-selected nominal model estimate: 5 um nominal mesh aperture, emerging jet diameter assumed equal to aperture; Rayleigh d_drop approximately 1.89*d_jet = 9.45 um, rounded to 10 um. Not measured sizing or a validated size distribution.

diameter_model.selection: Use droplet_diameters_um for every calculation; 9.45 um records motivation only. Replace configurable values and provenance when measured sizing is available.
diameter_model.applicability: Classical inviscid cylindrical-jet breakup motivates the estimate; applicability to this driven mesh atomiser and equality of emerging jet and aperture diameters are not validated.

release_definition: Lowest common gas-supported native PZT plane across co_directed.release_column_offsets; initialise both measured ensemble-mean components once
properties_assumptions: Pressure 101325 Pa; water at the recorded air temperature of 20 C; dry-air properties approximate unknown humidity
local_stokes_timescale: D0 / norm(prescribed local mean gas velocity), not a nozzle-exit or forcing-frequency timescale

co_directed.reference_planes: Match source comparison coordinates at their numerically calculated crossing; align measured PZT fixed-line reference to measured gas centreline at that plane, not physical exits
co_directed.plume_reference: Existing fixed native column through global finite PZT mean-v maximum; empirical reference, not established physical outlet
